body:
P2-25 SLICE 1 BUILT, PR #104 (draft, not merged; the item stays todo: slices 2 to 4 remain). What the next reader needs.

SHIPPED. textnorm.py, a new section (the five old functions and every caller untouched): fold, words, key_text(text, original=None), survives_fold_whole (ERA 0, what N-34 imports) and survives_fold_whole_era_1 (era 1, live-tested against the fixture's second column; slice 2 makes the first call the second), UNICODE_VERSION = 15.0.0, TEXTNORM_REVISION = 1, DECORATING_MARKS, PROTECTED_LETTERS, FOLDED_LETTERS. Phone: app/lib/domain/text_fold.dart (textFold, textWords; asks the platform for nothing) + generated text_fold_table.g.dart (99 KB). ONE fixture app/test/fixtures/text/fold-cases.json read by tests/test_textnorm.py (301 tests) and app/test/domain/text_fold_test.dart (180): 107 fold, 40 meet, 25 differ, 45 survives, 21 keys rows written by hand + a generated corpus (digests of the fold of EVERY code point, of the letter/number/mark classes, of 20,000 seeded strings). Tool: tools/gen_text_fold_table.py [--check]; server.yml runs --check on 3.12.

RED FIRST. The rows against the OLD functions: 78 of 107 fold, 12 of 40 meet, 25 of 25 differ, 19 of 21 key rows fail. 20,000 seeded ASCII strings give the old word list exactly.

THE PIN. Unicode 15.0.0 = Python 3.12.13 (run). This machine's 3.13 has 15.1.0, which differs ONLY by 627 added code points (checked on 7 properties of every code point); tests skip those on a 3.13 (textfold_corpus.ASSIGNED_AFTER_PIN), so both Pythons are green. The tool REFUSES any other Unicode: run `uv run --python 3.12 python -X utf8 tools/gen_text_fold_table.py` (uv python install 3.12 once). TRAP: moving ONLY the image to Python 3.13 would make words() read 622 CJK Extension I ideographs as letters with no test red (the skip hides them): move image, server.yml and the pin in one PR.

DESIGN CORRECTIONS (the design is updated). (1) Step 6 (invisible characters) runs FIRST: in the drawn order kana + joiner + voiced mark stayed uncomposed and fold was not idempotent (run). (2) key_text's last fallback is the NFKC case-folded original, not fold(original): a title that is only a tatweel or only harakat keeps a non-empty key and two such titles differ. (3) "No L/N code point gives an empty key" is false: the tatweel, the presentation forms that are a space + harakat (U+FC5E...) and the halfwidth voiced marks are exceptions (a test lists them). (4) words drops a run made only of marks; fold collapses no spaces. (5) The table is 99 KB, not 64 KB (mark removal needs NFD and NFC).

DEVIATIONS FROM THE SLICE TABLE (yours to overrule). normalizeForMatch is NOT on the Dart fold (the brief: no behaviour change; it changes matching and the cover cache key): a follow-up. ARTIST_SPLIT and _BRACKETS untouched (they change what callers see: slice 2). Lucene sources NOT checked (no network); the fixture says so.

FOR SLICE 2. Change test_old_functions_are_still_the_ones_the_callers_use; point the keys rows at refs.norm_key (rows are already artist|title|version); survives_fold_whole = era 1; raise TEXTNORM_REVISION only when a result changes. N-34 slice 1 may now import textnorm.survives_fold_whole.

NOT CHECKED. Dart table parse cost on a phone (20 ms on the PC JIT, then 31 us per title; ~15,000 entries held as maps after the first non-ASCII use), the emulator.
